thread:
alex: Heads-up — release cut is blocked, staging-e2e is failing on commit abc123. Seeing a lot of artifact restore errors from deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: [automated] promote attempt blocked: artifact-restore error (blob mount 412 -> 503). Logs: 
```
503 Service Unavailable: upstream error when fetching layers
error: checksum mismatch for layer sha256:deadbeef -> expected 4f5a got 3b2c
```
riz: Reproduced locally: the e2e that hits the feature-flag service times out. Failing test is tests/e2e/feature_flag_spec.py::test_flag_evaluation (timeout after 30s). Also saw a spurious 502 from mirror during `docker pull`.
sara: Is this the same flake we saw yesterday? If so last good image was release-2026-03-18-rc2. We can pin to that image to unblock, but that means skipping the latest changes.
elaine: Pinning will skip the DB migration in the new build — we need to ensure migration is not required for customer-facing changes. Any migration in this cut?
kevin: There is a lightweight migration (add nullable col) in abc123 but it's safe to defer. Pinning to rc2 should be fine for the immediate cut, but we should track the migration for the next window.
alex: Options: (1) retry artifact restore / reupload, (2) pin to last-good image and promote, (3) rollback the merge that introduced the failing test, or (4) hold the cut until we fix infra mirror. Thoughts?
riz: Quick check: I can try reuploading the build artifact and force a promote. If the mirror was transient it should pass. Command I ran: `curl -X POST https://deploy-api/reupload -d '{"image":"abc123"}'` — got 202 then later 503. I can re-run now.
sara: If reupload fails, I prefer pin+promote for predictable SLA. We can do a hotfix branch for the test later.
elain: @sam — what's the impact on the change window if we hold?
sam: Change window is 10:00–12:00 UTC. We're at 09:37 UTC. I don't want to extend beyond the window without exec sign-off. Decision: try reupload for 10 minutes, if unsuccessful pin to release-2026-03-18-rc2 and promote. If reupload succeeds and e2e passes, promote latest. If neither, we rollback the merge that added feature-flag change.
deploy-bot: [automated] reupload started for abc123 at 6977778895. Status: queued to eu-mirror nodes.
riz: Reupload returned 202 then propagated; I kicked a staging promote job. Running e2e now.
deploy-bot: [automated] staging promote job started (job id 9843), awaiting smoke/e2e.
deploy-bot: [automated] staging e2e result: 12/13 passed, tests/e2e/feature_flag_spec.py failed (timeout).
kevin: Looks like the test is still flaky. I'm going to run it with higher timeout locally and add extra logging to see if the feature-flag service is slow or if it's the network.
sam: Ok we hit the 10-minute window. @sara proceed with pin-and-promote to release-2026-03-18-rc2. Make sure release notes mention rollback decision and follow-up ticket for the test and mirror stability.
sara: Will do. Creating a short release note line and opening ticket INFRA-4321 for mirror investigation + QA-210 for test flake. Pushing promote to pinned image now.
deploy-bot: [automated] manual promote to release-2026-03-18-rc2 initiated by sara at 6977778948.
alex: Thanks team. After promote completes, let's schedule a short post-mortem for the mirror + flaky test; we should not keep pinning long-term. :thumbsup:
